reality_notes: Our previous analyst built a technically strong dashboard, but the sales team never used it because nobody had asked them what they actually needed.
They also underestimated how messy the source data was and spent weeks fixing duplicates without telling anyone that the schedule was slipping.
Things only improved once they started short weekly check-ins with the business users and shared unfinished versions early.
